1.mascotDialogue: The pivot don't move again after partitionin' — it's already home. Everything left to sort is strictly smaller on one side and strictly bigger on the other.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 9 sets the pivot at its final restin' index. Lines 16 and 17 then recurse on the strictly-smaller and strictly-bigger sides — the pivot itself never gets touched again.

3.mascotDialogue: This pivot happened to be the smallest value, so it ends up clean at index 0 — an unlucky pivot pick, and a right good example of why pivot choice matters for performance.

4.mascotDialogue: One character off — p instead of p minus 1 — and the recursion loses its most important guarantee: every recursive call workin' on a strictly smaller range than the last. One character, whole guarantee gone.
